note: Rounding factor round (maintainer request, 2026-11-04). Before v0.1: no deprecated aliases. NLAlib.Computation.roundingFactor n u changes value from Higham's nu/(1 - nu) to (1 - u)^{-n} - 1 of Carson, Ma and Shao (arXiv 2610.35420, (3)); every lemma about it and every BLAS trace and kernel bound (dot, axpy, gemv, gemm, trsvLower) now assumes u < 1 (u_p < 1 for the kernels) in place of nu < 1 (2u < 1 for axpy), and the bounds read with the new factor. The composition rule becomes an equality and is renamed accordingly (roundingFactor_add_add_mul_le -> roundingFactor_add_add_mul). abs_inv_one_add_sub_one_le now bounds a single inverted rounding error, |(1 + δ)^{-1} - 1| ≤ γ_1, in place of the γ_{2j} bound from |θ| ≤ γ_j (inverses of counted products are IsRoundingProduct.inv). Higham's nu/(1 - nu) survives only in roundingFactor_le. Result ids are unchanged.
